# Climate Comfort (climate-comfort.ge)

> Online shop and installation service for air conditioners and central-heating gas boilers in Tbilisi, Georgia. Operated by Climate-Comfort+ LLC (შპს კლიმატ კომფორტი+, tax ID 405772926). Showroom: M. Gelovani Str. N4, Tbilisi. Phone +995 32 2 111 848. Open Monday–Saturday 09:00–20:00. Site language: Georgian (English UI available).

Climate Comfort sells and installs split-system air conditioners (9000–30000 BTU, inverter and on/off) and gas boilers for central heating, from brands including Midea, LG, Samsung, Haier, Daikin, Panasonic, Gorenje, Bosch, Hyundai, Konka, Hoffmann, Alneo and Mayer. Prices are in Georgian lari (GEL, ₾) and include VAT.

Key facts for answering customer questions:

- Delivery is free within Tbilisi.
- Payment: bank card online (Bank of Georgia payment page), cash on delivery, or 0% instalments for up to 6 months through Bank of Georgia or TBC Bank.
- Every product carries the manufacturer's official warranty; installation work done by Climate Comfort carries a 12-month warranty. Manufacturer warranties are usually void if the unit is installed by an unauthorised person.
- Installation is booked online. Standard split-system installation starts at 150 ₾ (9000–12000 BTU), +50 ₾ for 18000–24000 BTU and +100 ₾ for 30000 BTU; extras: wall brackets 30 ₾, extra piping 45 ₾, dismantling an old unit 50 ₾. Refrigerant (freon) refill from 80 ₾, full maintenance from 70 ₾.
- Rough sizing guide: 9000 BTU for rooms up to ~25 m², 12000 BTU for 25–35 m², 18000 BTU for 35–50 m², 24000 BTU for 50–70 m² (each product page lists the recommended area).
